note: Each platform's node tags and the identity circuits' buffers for it: the
constants of src/table.nr, which scripts/identity_table.py generates from
this file. A node is SHA256(tag || value): the id node over the id as the
platform sent it, the handle node over the folded handle. A tag is raw
ASCII of 1 to 31 bytes, so bearer-link takes it as one Field; the tags
are distinct and prefix-free, so no two platforms and no id and handle
share a node. maxHandle and maxId are the circuits' buffers: a longer
value is refused, never truncated. idShape is `decimal` for an id of
digits and `string` for any JSON string.
Every release ships this file beside the verifiers, and libID-contracts
generates its CeremonyProfile tags and its Rust and TypeScript tables
from the shipped copy. Changing a value changes what a deployed verifier
The address as proved: no dot is removed, no +tag stripped and no domain
rewritten. A longer one is refused, not truncated. The id is the OIDC sub.
